tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug bcas la phyag mchod gsol ba gdab ba'i cho ga thub bstan rgyas pa'i dpal yon kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru mu nīn+d+rā ya/ zas gtsang sras gang 'das dus tshangs byung mchog gi srid pa bzung tsa na// sems dpa' gzhan gyis bor ba'i lnga bdo'i 'gro la thugs rje'i shugs bskyed de// g.yar dam brgya phrag lnga yi khur chen bzhes la rin chen snying po sogs// rgyal ba kun gyis pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i rnam thar rjes su dran// thub dbang chos kyis sras po snying stobs che// gdul bya'i dbang gis dgra bcom skur bstan te// bstan pa skyong phyir sku tshe byin brlabs pa'i// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod bya kun gyi mchog /de phyir gangs can mgon po a ti sha'i// phyag bzhes thams cad mkhyen pa mchims sogs kyis// gsal mdzod cho ga 'dzin dang brjod bde bar// bsdebs 'di thub pa'i drin shes kun gyis zung*// de yang rgyal ba'i dbang po gzhan gyis ma thul ba'i rtsod ldan dus kyi 'gro ba ma rungs pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs gcig pu bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la drin du gzo ba'i bya ba sde snod rin po che nyan bshad sgrub gsum gyis 'dzin skyong la lhag par spro ba'i skyes bu blo gros can rnams kyis ni/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po 'di rnams la bsnyen bkur zhing gsol ba gdab pa la brtson par bya dgos te/ ston pa bka' drin can nyid kyis 'phags pa 'di dag la bstan pa gtad cing bka' bsgos pas yar 'phel gyi tshe lo bdun brgya pa'i bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par bshad cing*/ gang na dge 'dun gyi sde khrims gtsang zhing 'chad nyan smar ba der dngos dang sprul pas byon te byin gyis rlob par sngon gyi mkhas btsun rnams kyi rnam thar dang*/ dpal snar thang pa'i lo rgyus kyis shes pas ji ltar bsams pa'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod do// dgos pa de ldan gyi cho ga nyams su len pa la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi chos gsum gyi dang po ni/

gtsug lag khang sogs byi dor legs par byas la spos chus chag chag gdab/ bla re dang yol ba la sogs pas brgyan/ stegs yid du 'ong bar thig btab la spos chu'am tshon phyes gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa pha gu sogs spyi mthun tsam las rta babs rdo rwa sogs mi dgos par dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa bcas bris la lha gnas rnams su me tog gi tshom bu re dgod/ spros pa dang 'byor pa rab kyis ni lugs sku'am lder sku lta bu bkod kyang rung*/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ dkar gtor bzhi dang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa dri bzang gi chus bkang pa/ me long*/ sku phyi bcas/ 'byor na chos gos gsum dang*/ gding ba lhung bzed bcas gzhan du longs ma spyad pa/ 'khar gsil/ spyi blugs sogs rung mthun gyi yo byad rnams kyang bkod mdzes su bsham/ cho ga mkhan dge slong dge tshul thams cad kyis rang rgyud kyi ltung ba phyir bcos bshags sdom byin rlabs gang la gang 'os pa 'dul ba'i gzhung bzhin bya ba'am/ ma grub na 'di nyid la sngags lugs kyi rjes gnang yod pas bya rgyud spyi ltar rnam rgyal stong mchod sogs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i theg chen gso sbyong blangs kyang chog go /dngos gzhi ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ stan la 'khod de/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs spyi ltar gyi skyabs 'gro ci mang dang*/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum gyis skyabs sems sbrags ma dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ sa gzhi dang pho brang sogs byin gyis brlab pa bzhi'i dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir ston pa thub pa'i dbang po 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa sogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzoms pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i 'di rnams ji ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig gi phye ma gram bur brdal ba/ ut+pal dang*/ ku mu da dang*/ pad+ma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs par gyur cing*/ chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrogs pa/ dga' zhing 'phyo la lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing bu dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa la lha'i nor bu dang*/ mu tig gi rgyan phreng dang rin po che dpyangs pa/ me tog gi mgo lcogs dang 'bras bu mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing ldem pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sbrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod cing bsam mo// gnyis pa pho brang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis zhing khams de'i dbus su gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen por rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/

shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brten pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pas nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas/ dran pa dang blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pas 'gro ba/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen po 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod/ gsum pa gdan khri byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma bcu drug la rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ shar dang sgo bzhir pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan rnams bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang*/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/

'phags pa dge bsnyen dharmā tā dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i bzhugs gnas 'phags pa so so'i smon lam khyad par can dang*/ mnga' thang dang 'tshams par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis phyi nang kun tu yang cha rigs dang 'tshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang na bza' dang rgyan dang rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig 'phags pa thams cad kyang gdan 'dzoms nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas rol mo sna tshogs pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dhā na/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍ+yo pa sam̐ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs tshar gsum bton la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig ces bden stobs brjod/ de nas mchod yul spyan drang pa ni/ tshogs pa rnams bzhengs te bdug spos dang*/

mchod yon gyis bkang ba'i dung phor dang ting shag sogs rol mo phrogs shing*/ dbyangs snyan po dang bcas pas/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa// pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rje rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skem zhing*// rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bkas bstod pa'i// phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal// yon sbyor mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa// chos skyong dgra bcom chen po bzhugs so 'tshal// dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*// gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// lam brtan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// dgra bcom gnas brtan chen po de dag ni// bsod nams rin chen zhing du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin pa// khyad par can gyi phrin las chos skyong pa'i// gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa srung*// rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du// gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po// dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig brtan pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal// bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// phyogs dus kun gyi skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// zhes pa'i mthar rol mo bya zhing*/

thub pa 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs pas skad cig nyid la byon te gzhal yas khang gi dbus su so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod/ zhal phyag gsal gdab pa ni/ pad+ma'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor mngon par 'phags shing*/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ na bza' chos gos dur smrig tshon can gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus na zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bcu drug gi shar gyi 'dab ma bzhi la rim pa bzhin du gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin phyag na rin po che'i prog zhu bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam brtan phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon chos 'chad kyis phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// lho'i 'dab ma bzhi la rim pa bzhin du gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde pa phyag g.yas bum pa/ g.yon 'khar gsil bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po sbed byed phyag na glegs bam bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bsnams pa gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na spos phor bsnams shing mchan khung g.yon na rnga yab bsnams pa'o// nub kyi 'dab ma bzhi la gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/

gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad cing*/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po dus ldan phyag na gser gyi rna skor bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad cing*/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa'o// byang gi 'dab ma bzhi la gnas brtan chen po bzang po phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po gser be'u phyag na rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po ba ku la phyag na ne'u le bsnams pa'o// de dag kyang 'khor dgra bcom pa khri phrag gcig dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa ste/ thams cad kyang na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gyis mdzes shing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// sgo bzhi'i shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lha'i gos dang go chas brjid pa/ bstan pa srung ba'i las la brtson pa'i rnam pa can no// shar sgo'i nang du dge bsnyen chen po dharma tā phyag na rnga yab dang bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa thod du bcings shing sde snod gsum gyi glegs bam khur ba/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol zhing pus mo brdzes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag gi tshogs sprul pa/ dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ byon legs bya ba ni/ sngar gyi mchod yon bzed zhal du sbreng zhing*/

bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ khrus gsol ba ni/ rgyas par spro na/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// zhes snyan gsan dbab pa dang*/ spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba'i/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// zhes khrus kyi khang pa gsal 'debs pa 'di gnyis 'don ma thub na mos pa tsam bya'o// gang ltar yang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ khyed kyi rang bzhin yongs dag pas// srid pa'i 'ching ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba= de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= zhes pa yan gyis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/

zhes pas me long ngos la dri'i thig lnga byas la/ sku phyis kyis phyi ba'i tshul bya'o// spro na/ slar yang me long gi ngos la dri bzang byug cing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ dar gos ser po sogs 'bul tshul dang bcas/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smig rgyal mtshan phul pa yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /ces pa tsam mam/ spro na snam sbyar sogs dngos sam yid kyis dbul zhing*/ rgyu tshad dbyibs kyis rung ba kha bsgyur zhing*// snam phran glegs bur dras te legs drubs pa'i// chos gos snam sbyar phul bas 'gro ba kun// ngo tsha khrel yod dpal gyis mdzes par shog /de bzhin du thog mtha' gzhan 'dra ba la/ chos gos stod g.yogs zhes bsgyur bas bla gos dang*/ chos gos mthang sham zhes bsgyur bas mthang gos dbul/ tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ chos gos 'ding ba phul bas 'gro ba kun// yid 'ong 'phags pa'i kun spyod thob par shog /ces pas gding ba dang*/ rgyu tshad dbyibs kyis rung ba kha bsgyur ba'i// drang srong snod mchog bza' bca' bsod pa yis// bkang ste phul bas 'gro kun kham zas kyi// srid pa dang bral ting 'dzin zas thob shog /ces pas lhung bzed dang*/ lam bden chos kyi sgra 'byin gsil byed dang*// dge byed rgyun 'bebs ril ba spyi blug sogs// thub pas bsngags pa'i yo byad kun phul bas// 'gro kun 'phags pa'i rnam thar spyod par shog /ces pas nyer mkho gzhan rnams dbul lo// slar yang bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bsod nams bye ba las grub rin chen khri// 'khor ba'i skyon bral pad+ma 'dab rgyas dang*// rang bzhin 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la// dgyes par bzhugs nas bsnyen bkur bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ro// de nas gtso 'khor thams cad la thun mong du phyag dang mchod pa phul te gsol ba gdab pa ni/

sogs gong ltar dang*/ 'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i zhal zas 'di// thub pa'i bka' sdod rgyal chen bzhi la sogs// dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la// 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub par mdzod// gtor ma gsum pa saṃ bha ra bdun gyis bsngo zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ 'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di// pha ma rigs drug sems can yongs la bsngo// rang rang ji ltar 'dod pas tshim gyur nas// rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal las grol te// myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /gtor ma bzhi pa saṃ bha ra bdun gyis bsngo zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ 'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di// sa yi lha mo brtan mas gtso byas pa'i// yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs rnams la// mthun rkyen stong grogs yid bzhin sgrub par mdzod// bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig

/ces bden stobs brjod/ de nas gtang rag gi mchod pa bya ba ni/ mkha' mnyam 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te// stong gsum mi mjed zhing gi dpal gyur pa// 'dren mchog shākya'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*// gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// lam bstan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// gnas brtan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// zhes sogs nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o// sa gzhi spos chus= spyod par shog /thun mong du 'dod don gsol ba ni/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gis// 'khor tshogs srid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med// khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// sems can kun gyi gsos gyur dgra bcom pa// rig dang zhabs ldan skye rgu'i sbyin gnas che// 'phags pa'i gang zag chen po khyed rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cing*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas// srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs gyur cing*// ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag gyur te// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun rdzogs nas// lus can kun las khyad par 'phags par shog

/thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor bcas la// gsol ba btab pas phan bde kun gyi gzhi// rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /thub dbang bstan pa'i sgron me sa gsum gyi// 'gro ba'i mig gcig dpal ldan bla ma mchog /zhabs pad srid mthar brtan cing phrin las rgyas// thugs kyi bzhed don ma lus 'grub gyur cig /ces dang*/ spro na/ bdag gis bcom ldan khyed sku legs bsgoms zhing*// mthu chen gzungs sngags 'bad pas bzlas pa dang*// gus pas mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// 'dod don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// mtha' yas 'gro ba bdag dang bcas rnams la// mi bzad 'jigs dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu// las dang nyon mongs stobs ldan las byung ba'i// sdig pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol// sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i// dgra dang chom rkun gdol pas gtses pa dang*// gcan gzan 'jigs dang pha rol dmag tshogs sogs// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims kun dang*// bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen bco lnga sogs// lus srog dge la bar du gcod pa yi// 'byung po'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol// skar mda' ltung dang sa g.yos 'jigs pa dang*// byad stems mthu dang thog chen 'bebs pa sogs// mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa dang*// nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol// glo bur ye 'drog gnod pa ma lus dang*// dug dang sbyar dug kha zas ma zhu dang*// 'khon dang nyams grib 'bags dang mi gtsang sogs// dri ma thams cad zhi bar= /de ltar phyi nang lus sems sdug bsngal kun// rang gi las las byung mod de ltar na'ang*// dbang dang stobs bcu brnyes pa khyod kyi mthus// sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar= khyod kyis bdag gi sdug bsngal zil mnan cing*// bde ba'i las 'bras bzang po'i gsos btab nas// yang dag bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// las dang nyon mongs zhi bar=

/sngon dus 'khor bar lan mang 'khor ba'i tshe// gzhan srog bcad dang 'tsho ba phrogs pa sogs// tshe thung 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa// de kun byang zhing dag par= /khyad par tshe 'dir las dang bsod nams tshe// rgud cing nyams pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// khyed kyis 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// de kun byang zhing bkru bar mdzad du gsol// phun tshogs phan bde 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu// rgyal ba'i bstan pa chos kyis gzung ba'i phyir// tshe dang bsod nams rnam dag las bzang rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par= /dus min 'chi ba'i dgra las rnam rgyal zhing*// tshul khrims dag pa'i sdig med chos dang mthun pa'i kha zas kyis// lus kyi zo mdog rgyas par= /nad dang gnod med dga' mgur spyod pa dang*// tshe yi bar du gcod pa kun zhi nas// bshad sgrub bya bas nyin mtshan 'da' ba sogs// rnam dkar phrin las rgyas par= /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas// tshul khrims dag cing thos la mngon brtson pas// thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par= /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs 'chi med dbang po'i bang mdzod las// rmad byung blo dang tshe yi nor blangs nas// 'gro ba tshe yi dbul ba sel gyur cig /ces dang*/ 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// yul dus gnas skabs kun tu mi nyams par// phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// tshad med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i dpal mnga' zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srog pas gces 'dzin pa'i// mtshungs med bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// sku tshe ring zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// 'gro la dge ba'i lam bzang snang mdzad cing*// 'chad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba lhur len pa'i// chos byed dge 'dun de dag zhabs brtan zhing*// phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// mi rnams na rga 'chi bar 'jigs med cing*// 'jig rten yang dag lta ba dang ldan pas// phan tshun byams pa'i yid dang ldan gyur cing*// tshad med dga' ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol// grong rnams 'jam po'i rlung gis g.yo ba yis// ba dan dkar po'i phreng bas rab mdzes shing*// gos bzang rin chen rgyan dang ldan pa yi// 'byor ldan skye bos gang bar mdzad du gsol// mkha' la glog phreng 'gyu ba'i sprin mdzes shing*// sa la rma bya dga' ba'i gar mdzes pa// zim bu dal gyis 'bab pa'i char rgyun gyis// 'gro rnams dga' ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol// ri rnams rtswa dang me tog 'bab chus brgyan// klung rnams sna tshogs phyugs dang 'bru yis gang*// mi rnams rab tu dga' ba'i glu len zhing*// dregs dang 'thab rtsod med par mdzad du gsol// rgyal pos chab srid zhi bas legs skyong zhing*// 'bangs rnams rgyal po'i bka' lung gus len pas// phyi dang nang gi 'khrugs rtsod nyer zhi nas// rdzogs ldan bzhin du bde bar mdzad du gsol// gtsug lag khang rnams rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dang*// dam chos glegs bam du mas rab mdzes pa// lha rdzas mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag med kyis// mchod pa'i char chen rgyas par mdzad du gsol// dgon gnas thams cad thub bstan skyong byed pa// bshes gnyen ngur smrig 'dzin pas yongs gang ste// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' zhing*// klog dang kha ton rgyas par mdzad du gsol// dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong pha ma rnams// dri ma med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan zhing*// rnam dag thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba yis// bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol// sgrub pa po rnams g.yeng ba kun spangs nas// 'tshe ba kun bral 'du 'dzis rnam dben pa'i// zhi ba'i gnas su spong ba lhur len pa'i// rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas par mdzad du gsol// lhag par dad pas gsol bar 'debs byed pa// sgrub po bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// log 'tsho bral ba'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs dang*// tshe dang dam chos rgyas par mdzad du gsol// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab bla na med sogs kyis// rang la sangs rgyas chos kun yongs rdzogs nas// lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par mdzad du gsol// sbyin dang snyan par smra bas 'khor bsdus nas// don spyod dam chos tshul bzhin bshad pa'i mthus// rang gzhan don mthun chos la legs sbyar nas// gzhan don chos bzhin rgyas par mdzad du gsol// chos kyi 'gal rkyen mtha' dag nyer zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs gyur nas// gang dang gang la thub pas rab bsngags pa'i// dge ba de dag rgyas par mdzad du gsol// thub dbang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi byin rlabs dang*// chos kun de bzhin nyid kyi bden pa dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus// ji ltar gsol ba btab bzhin 'grub gyur cig

/ces gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// 'di nyid rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum nas bshus pa yin pas chos spyod dpar ma dang ma mthun kyang dag pa'i rgyu mtshan go ba can gyis shes so// de nas nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang*/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas/ ma 'tshal ba dang bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang*/ mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa dang*/ gtsang sbra ma byed pa dang*/ cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhes shing 'phral dang yun du bdag cag rnams la sgrib par mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal gang*// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// de nas rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du zhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor bas brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyis gshegs gsol bya'o// de nas shis pa brjod pa ni/ che ba'i che mchog sogs nas bde skyid ldan par shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi// phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med// skal ba mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje yis// nyan thos tshul du srid pa ji srid bar// bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shis shog /'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge yi// bdag rkyen las byung rgyu 'bras bstan gnyis kyi// bshad sgrub rgyun bzang ris su ma chad pa// kun kyang dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan skya

gong mos kha bsgyur/ pa sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i sogs dang*/ e waṃ chos ldan gtsor gyur chos grwa kun// 'dus tshogs li khri'i rgya mtsho ltar rgyas shing*// chos spyod rlabs phreng srid pa'i rtser 'phyur bas// bdud sde'i grong khyer 'jig pa'i bkra shis shog /ma pham chos kyi bla ma g.yag rong gnyis// rig pa'i dbang phyug grags pa bzang po dang*// sde snod 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan rdzong dkar ba'i// bstan pa slar yang dar ba'i bkra shis shog /thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa'i// lta grub 'khrul med seng ge'i nga ro yis// phas rgol glang po'i klad 'gems go ram che'i// ring lugs phyogs brgyar 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog /gang gi zhabs sen yid la dran tsam gyis// phyi nang bdud las rgyal ba'i dpal yon can// rdo rje 'chang dngos tshar pa chos kyi rje'i// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs la khyab// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo// bstan pa 'dzin 'dod lhag bsam dkar ldan dang*// gang dag don gyis dben kyang khas 'che rnams// bstan pa'i gtso bo bstan skyong bcas pa la// gsol gdab tshul 'di las dang las 'dra zung*// 'di kos phan dang phan pa'i gzugs brnyan du// 'gyur ba de dang de 'dra'i gang zag la// rag mod brtsams pa'i dge ba bcos min de// 'gro kun thub pa'i ye shes rtogs phyir bsngo// bsod nams rdzogs ldan sprin gyi dus ston gyis// 'jig rten gsum du shis pa sgrub pa dang*// dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing*// 'khor lo gsum gyis bstan pa skyong gyur cig

/ces thub dbang gnas brtan bcas la phyag mchod gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga thub bstan rgyas pa'i dpal yon kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mchims thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' grags kyi cho gar/ lha bkod dus sgra gcan 'dzin nas mgo brtsams zhing*/ gsol ba gdab dus yan lag 'byung gis thog drangs pa 'di 'phags chen gyi gsung dgongs gzhi khyad par can yod pa gor ma chag pas ma bcos pa gzhir bzung*/ gnas brtan rtogs brjod dang*/ cho ga phyi ma rnams la dpyad cing ngag 'don bde ba'i rigs 'ga' zhig blangs te/ rgyal khams pa ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer zhes bod pas/ me 'brug dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la mdo smad lhun grub steng gi chos grwar sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
